description.ja: 『機動戦士ガンダム外伝 宇宙、閃光の果てに・・・』に登場した機体、ガンダム５号機がＨＧシリーズに登場。
description.en: Gundam Unit 5, the aircraft that appeared in "Mobile Suit Gundam Gaiden: At the End of the Flash...", is now available in the HG series.

description.ja: 胸部に新規造形を交え、５号機のフォルムを実現。主兵装ジャイアント・ガトリングは砲身部に新規パーツを用い忠実に再現。
description.en: With new modeling on the chest, the form of Unit 5 has been realized. The main weapon, the Giant Gatling, is faithfully reproduced using new parts in the gun barrel.

description.ja: ●　特徴的な機体フォルムを新規造形を交え再現！
description.en: ● Reproduce the characteristic aircraft form with new modeling!

description.ja: ガンダム４号機をベースに、宇宙仕様の特徴的な機体フォルムを新規造形を交えて徹底再現。
description.en: Based on Gundam Unit 4, the characteristic aircraft form of space specifications is thoroughly reproduced with new modeling.

description.ja: レッド、ダークグレーなどの特徴的なカラーも、パーツ分割による成形色にて再現。
description.en: Characteristic colors such as red and dark gray are also reproduced by molding colors by dividing the parts.

description.ja: 胸部
description.en: chest

description.ja: ４号機とは形状が異なる胸部を新規パーツで再現。
description.en: The chest, which has a different shape from Unit 4, is reproduced with new parts.

description.ja: ●　主兵装「ジャイアント・ガトリング」を新規造形を交え色分け再現！
description.en: ● The main weapon "Giant Gatling" is reproduced in different colors with new modeling!

description.ja: 砲身部を新規パーツを交え色分け再現。給弾ベルトを介して左腰部に装備された大型ドラムマガジンと接続。
description.en: The gun barrel is reproduced in different colors with new parts. Connected to a large drum magazine mounted on the left waist via a bullet feeding belt.

description.ja: 給弾ベルトは軟質素材を採用し、各種アクションポーズにも柔軟に対応可能
description.en: The bullet feeding belt is made of soft material and can be flexibly adapted to various action poses.

description.ja: ●　部隊章などを再現するマーキングシールが付属。
description.en: ● Includes MarkingSeal that reproduces unit badges, etc.

description.ja: 付属武装 ： ジャイアント・ガトリング　／　ハイパー・ビーム・ライフル　／　シールド　／　ビーム・サーベル
